attempts.summary: Configured OPNsense on node1 to port-forward TCP 80 on its LAN address (10.100.19.10, shared with node2/node3) to node2's HTTP service on 10.100.19.11:8080, with NAT reflection (hairpin) enabled so node3 reaches the service through node1's address rather than node2 directly. Verified via packet capture that node2 sees the request's source rewritten to node1's address, proving true hairpin NAT. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity changes confirmed and full recovery verified after each.
